meaning_carrier_intelligence.opening_meaning: the key is a maintenance tool Noor uses as routine maintenance before the wreck
meaning_carrier_intelligence.closing_reversal: the same key opens the foghorn line that drives the crab into the tide gate and frees trapped passengers
meaning_carrier_intelligence.final_sequence_use: the object operates the final light/sound/trap mechanism before the rescued group reaches the dead lighthouse transformed into a sounding beacon guiding survivors and sea creatures home
meaning_carrier_intelligence.craft_rule: A physical object, space, sound-object, or ritual should carry the wound in the opening and return with changed meaning in the payoff.

fields.power_asymmetry: predator-controlled terrain versus an injured professional with only knowledge, tools, and attention to vulnerable life

relational_contract_intelligence.craft_rule: Power-asymmetric relationships are strongest when safety or costly kindness precedes power, and the ending repairs consent/personhood rather than rewarding coercion.

warnings: opening does not establish a legible spatial status grammar (who is caged, seated, kneeling, serving, or excluded)
spatial_status_intelligence.doctrine: Define who is physically forced below/outside/inside power, then make the ending transform that space into chosen access, sanctuary, or belonging. Inspired by floor/table and cage/sanctuary evidence.

closure_integrity.craft_rule: A plot sequel hook may remain, but only after the promised recognition, home, belonging, and community consequence have landed.

visual_causality.doctrine: Every scene should remain broadly intelligible when muted: visible protector/protected relation, physical action, object/space consequence, and a final image changed by the turn.

compressed_survival_integrity.craft_rule: Compressed creature survival should pay a legible role/creature/location contract early, build muted visual objectives, differentiate predator from vulnerable/cooperative life, use occupational competence as climax machinery, convert escape into reciprocal rescue, and close through recognition/contact rather than explosion alone.
